name: ship-feature-gate
description: PreToolUse Bash gate that blocks high-signal shipping commands outside a fresh /ship-feature run. A fresh active marker at ~/.ship-feature/active/<session>.json authorizes shipping-class operations after Stage 0 claims the Linear ticket.
known_limitations: The classifier is intentionally high-signal and does not try to parse every possible shell obfuscation or deployment tool. It blocks the known shipping paths named in XOS-47 while avoiding false positives on feature branch pushes and ordinary development commands.
Settings activation is human-gated; scripts/preflight-ship-feature-gate.ts is present but this manifest does not imply it is wired into ~/.claude/settings.json.
related_invariant: Agentic SDLC / ship-feature enforcement / SDLC WORK-CLAIM
litmus: Before PR creation, main push, deploy, or ship-* command: is there a fresh ~/.ship-feature/active/<session>.json marker from Stage 0 of the ship-feature pipeline? If no — BLOCK and route through the skill.
origin: XOS-47, 2026-06-09 — enforce Agentic SDLC by making /ship-feature the default path for code shipping and blocking ad-hoc PR/deploy commands outside a claimed run.
